hero.title: Master's in Computer Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue an elite Master of Science in Computer and Microengineering in Switzerland at ETH Zurich and EPFL, continental Europe's highest-ranked technical universities, benefiting from precision microtechnology research and low public semester fees.

overview: Switzerland represents the pinnacle of European technical research and microengineering precision, home to the prestigious federal institutes of technology and premier international corporate research laboratories. Studying a Master of Science in Computer Engineering in Switzerland offers Indian students unparalleled academic prestige, world-class research infrastructure, and direct exposure to pioneering semiconductor and robotic innovation.

Swiss federal institutes (ETH Zurich, EPFL) and cantonal research universities deliver rigorous 1.5- to 2-year English-taught Master of Science programs (90–120 ECTS). Coursework encompasses Advanced Computer Architecture, VLSI and Integrated Circuit Design, Hardware Security & Cryptography, Embedded Deep Learning Accelerators, and Neuromorphic Computing, with very low public tuition fees (CHF 500 to CHF 1,220 per semester) and access to cutting-edge cleanrooms and semiconductor research centers.

Graduates of Swiss master's engineering programs are among the most sought-after hardware researchers and silicon design engineers in the world. Under Article 21, paragraph 3 of the Foreign Nationals and Integration Act (FNIA / AIG), non-EU graduates can apply for a residence permit for up to 6 months to secure qualified employment of high economic or scientific interest, facilitating seamless transitions to employer-sponsored Swiss work authorization.
